faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PR Professional post at IIT Bhubaneswar?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the PR Professional position at IIT Bhubaneswar is 23rd August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the PR Professional role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a 1st class Master's degree in Journalism & Mass Communication, Public Relations, Communications, or Media & Communication, along with 2-3 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the PR Professional post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the PR Professional position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary ranging from Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the PR Professional job at IIT Bhubaneswar?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure you prepare your bio-data, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the PR Professional post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the PR Professional post at IIT Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the PR Professional recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a skill test followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is PRA/875/26-27.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position.
